samples.question: This picture contains one ribbon: a chain of coloured square cells joined end to end by short dark bridges, so the whole chain is a single connected strip that wanders from one side of the ribbon to the other. Each cell holds some dark pips, between one and four of them. Read the ribbon in order starting from its left-hand end cell and following the bridges to its right-hand end cell. A solid dark triangular tab is welded to the top edge of exactly one cell: that is the cell where the token starts. The token then makes exactly three hops. For each hop, count the pips in the cell the token is on now and move the token that many cells forward along the ribbon, counting every cell it passes over. The cell's colour never affects anything, and every grey mark outside the ribbon is inert decoration. After the three hops, how many pips are in the cell the token ends on? Answer with one of 1, 2, 3 or 4.
